# Tilak Dave

> Product engineer working on AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), connectors, and scalable web platforms.

Tilak Dave is a Product Engineer based in Hyderabad, India, working at Workato on AI agent architectures, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, custom connectors, and scalable web applications.
